what_would_change_verdict: Up: a VIN with a clean history report corroborating 84k miles and a documented timing belt/water pump job
Up: a clean independent PPI showing a dry underside, healthy rear air suspension and no codes
Down: an original timing belt with no records, plus the dealer refusing to adjust the price or allow a PPI
Down: frame rust, out-of-state history, accident reports or an odometer discrepancy on the history report
evidence.mission_note: A stock GX470 squarely supplies the body-on-frame 4WD and roof-rack camping capability the RX 350 lacks, so it fits the utility_capability branch if that capability is genuinely wanted. Accelerated-bridge mode still means no waiving the PPI or the records request.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a visually stock, tidy 2007 GX470 at a local Salinas dealer (Enzo's Motors, per the photo backdrop and plate frames), asking $20,999 against a fair-value mid of $21,337. Observed in the photos: scuffs on both rear bumper corners and hazed headlights. There is no visible modification, and the stance is level. Everything that drives GX470 value is unproven: no VIN, no history report, no timing belt/water pump record on a 19-year-old engine, and no evidence on rear air suspension, radiator, underside rust, tire ages or warning lights. The 84,436-mile figure is a claim, and the odometer is not legible in the attached photos. The listing went pending in September and was relisted with a $1,000 cut, which is an open question rather than a finding. Proximity to Carmel makes verification cheap and fast.
evidence.next_action: Message the dealer for the VIN, any service records (especially a timing-belt invoice) and the out-the-door price, then book an independent PPI in Salinas/Monterey focused on the timing belt, radiator, rear air suspension and underside before any deposit.
